newsitem.title: USA: DecisionOne closes merger with DLJ afiliate.
newsitem.headline: DecisionOne closes merger with DLJ afiliate.

text.p: DecisionOne Holdings Corp said Thursday it closed its recapitalization merger with Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette affiliate DLJ Merchant Banking Partners II LP.

The company said its shareholders--who could choose between receiving $23 in cash a share or retaining their stock-- elected to retain 12.2 million shares, eight times more than the available 1.5 million shares.
The company said it sharesholders will probably receive 12 percent of the shares they wanted to retain. It will announce a final pro-ration factor August 15.

DecisionOne's shares -- which were halted Thursday -- will trade on a "when-issued basis" under a temporary symbol on Nasdaq until the companies complete the physical exchange of certificates for the retained shares, a company statement said. It added the securities will trade under the same ticker symbol DOCI after the exchange.
Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities provided $810 million in financing for the merger, including $575 million in senior secured debt and $235 milion of high yield financings.
DesicionOne of Frazier, Pa., provides computer maintenance services.
